SAP Application Access Troubleshooting Guide

If you are unable to access the SAP application, follow these steps:

  1. Verify network connectivity: Ensure you can reach the SAP server by pinging sap-prod.company.com. Check that ports 3200-3399 are not blocked by your local firewall.
  2. Check credentials: Verify your SAP credentials are valid. If your password expired, reset it via the SAP Identity Management portal.
  3. Clear browser cache: SAP Web GUI can cache stale session tokens. Clear your browser cache and cookies, then try again.
  4. Check SAP server status: Visit the SAP System Status dashboard to confirm all modules are operational.
  5. VPN requirement: If working remotely, ensure your VPN is connected before accessing SAP.

If the issue persists after these steps, escalate to the SAP Basis team with your SAP client number and error screenshot.
